resources.string: When you keep snoozing, Nudgi steps up: an overlay over the app, then a countdown, then closing it. If you really need an app right now, pause that for an hour. Nudges still come as notifications meanwhile.
Everything Nudgi records stays on this phone, and uninstalling the app deletes it. Export it to a zip file to keep a copy: you choose where it is saved, and it goes nowhere else.
The export failed and no file was kept. Try again, or pick another location.
